thread:
Maria: Heads-up — vendor sent updated ETAs: H200 backlog +8-12 weeks for EU, +12-18 for APAC. Need to decide procurement signal window and whether we mix L40S to hit Q4 GPU-hour commitments.
Aj: Do we have a quick gap calc if H200 slips 12w? Can bursts on H100 or L40S close it?
Maria: Quick sketch (rough):
```
Assumptions: Q4 demand = 1.2M GPU-hours
Reserved H200 = 800k hours
If H200 delayed 12w -> effective H200 = 600k hours
Shortfall = 1.2M - 600k = 600k hours
L40S throughput ~= 0.6x H200 -> need ~1.0M L40S-hours to cover equivalent
H100 spot throughput ~= 0.85x H200 -> need ~700k H100-hours
```
Maria: So unit cost and mix matter a lot here.
Vikram: Two notes: 1) APAC customs + vendor cadence is the main delta. 2) Treat procurement signal latency as first-class in the runway calc (ordering cadence + vendor churn).
Sofia: Customs trending +10 days for some chassis in SEA. Also rack density changes with L40S — cooling/PSU constraints if we mix families.
Aj: Routing policy question: keep latency-sensitive traffic on H200; push embeddings/batch rerank to L40S? Need a QoS policy to avoid regression.
Maria: Proposed priority table:
- Priority A (low-latency SLO): H200 reserved
- Priority B (throughput / embeddings): L40S
- Priority C (non-critical / cost): H100 spot/ephemeral
Also propose dynamic routing: prefer H200 if tail <50ms, else fall back to L40S/H100.
infra-bot: Reminder: Reserved commit for H200 (EU-q4-commit) expires in 21 days unless renewed. :bell:
Tyler: Finance prefer converting ~20% of new capex into opex (spot) to preserve runway. Suggest a 40/40/20 mix (H200/L40S/spot-H100) for initial order.
Vikram: Tradeoffs: that mix reduces guaranteed Priority A throughput. I'll run perf sims and tail-latency risk matrix this afternoon.
Maria: Also consider splitting orders across two vendors to reduce lead-time variance — tradeoff is integration/support complexity.
Sofia: Ops checklist for mixed fleet:
- Verify PSU/cooling headroom per DC
- Validate kernel optimizations (L40S quant paths)
- Update rack layout and cabling docs
- Customs/incoterms harmonization for vendor B
Aj: Action items:
- @Vikram: perf sims + latency risk matrix by EOD
- @Maria: draft procurement signal window (12/24/36w) + cost model
- @Sofia: ops feasibility for mixing L40S into existing racks
- @Tyler: reconcile with finance + produce preferred mix
Maria: If everyone OK I'll open procurement thread and attach the risk matrix. Aim to finalize mix in 5 business days. :white_check_mark:
Sofia: I'll check APAC customs lead vendors and report back.
infra-bot: New vendor SLA templates uploaded to /vendor/contracts. Logged this thread to capacity-ops.
Aj: Thanks all — short & sharp, very helpful. :+1:
